scenes.title: The idea the filter missed
scenes.viewerPurpose: A rejection may involve recognition as well as quality. Proposes testing whether research evaluation loses decisive novelty during representation and favors familiar descriptions of innovation. Originality, usefulness and truth need separate attention.
scenes.composition: An unfamiliar proposal reaches a filter beside a rejection whose explanation remains open. Use one strong scene title, flat uncluttered backgrounds, and enough quiet space for the current caption.

cues.text: A research filter rejects an unfamiliar idea; was it weak, or simply hard to recognize?
cues.visualAction: An unfamiliar proposal reaches a filter beside a rejection whose explanation remains open.
cues.emotion: Open curiosity; gently emphasize “hard to recognize”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

cues.text: Novelty That Resembles the Past investigates whether AI research filters discard the differences that make an idea new.
cues.visualAction: Keep the proposal’s distinctive assumption visible next to its more familiar summary.
cues.emotion: Clear and warmly interested; give a small emphasis to “discard the differences”, then finish at an ordinary conversational pace without a dramatic rise.

cues.visualAction: Separate three reading questions about novelty, usefulness and truth without using scores.
cues.emotion: Patient clarity; gently emphasize “new”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

scenes.viewerPurpose: A summary can remove the decisive contribution. The problem occurs during a process. The proposed bias still needs testing.

cues.text: A summary can keep a proposal’s subject while losing the assumption that made it different.
cues.visualAction: Let a short summary omit the marked assumption while the original stays beside it.
cues.emotion: Quiet concern; gently emphasize “losing the assumption”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

cues.text: The book follows how that difference can disappear as an idea moves toward evaluation.

scenes.title: Room for the unfamiliar
scenes.viewerPurpose: An unfamiliar idea deserves accurate understanding. The opening rejection leaves a worthwhile question.
scenes.composition: A reader restores the original assumption before considering any ranking. Use one strong scene title, flat uncluttered backgrounds, and enough quiet space for the current caption.
